import difflib
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys

root = Path('/home/linhao/Toolchain/development/LogAnalysisSkill')
tools = root / 'docs/clang-fix-campaign/tools'
sys.path.insert(0, str(tools))
import terminal_registry as R

path = 'docs/clang-fix-campaign/p49-terminal-batch-design-v1.31-FROZEN.md'
old = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', '8338889:'+path], cwd=root)
new = (root/path).read_bytes()
assert hashlib.sha256(old).hexdigest() == '66b33ef6c365c3da835529756d60ee43626768a0d361eb47dbeea86177f6db3c'
assert hashlib.sha256(new).hexdigest() == 'b5c2dce6568b722a70ceb92ed7860ecda4417ca8895310df4bdbf7ae9158cec3'
ops = [op for op in difflib.SequenceMatcher(None,old.splitlines(keepends=True),new.splitlines(keepends=True),autojunk=False).get_opcodes() if op[0] != 'equal']
assert len(ops) == 2 and all(op[0] == 'insert' for op in ops), ops
assert ops[0][1:3] == (11,11) and ops[0][4]-ops[0][3] == 1
assert ops[1][1] == len(old.splitlines())
diff = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'diff', '--unified=0', '8338889', '--', path], cwd=root).decode()
assert not any(line.startswith('-') and not line.startswith('---') for line in diff.splitlines())
print('INTAKE old_sha256='+hashlib.sha256(old).hexdigest())
print('INTAKE new_sha256='+hashlib.sha256(new).hexdigest())
print('INTAKE insertion_hunks=2 deleted_lines=0 opcodes='+repr(ops))
print(diff)
data = tools / 'p49_terminal_data'
(data/'entry_registry.json').write_text(json.dumps(R.required_from_authority(root),ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
registry = [{'branch':b,'detector_owner':o,**({'form':b.removeprefix('consumer.')} if b.startswith('consumer.') else {})} for b,o in R.authority(root).items()]
(data/'capability_registry.json').write_text(json.dumps(registry,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
R.load_registry(root)
print(f'REGISTRATION kinds={len(R.required_from_authority(root))} branches={len(registry)} consumer={sum(r["branch"].startswith("consumer.") for r in registry)} (not SEAL evidence)')
